schema_note: Lens-only (intrinsics + OpenCV k1,k2,p1,p2,k3) for the three SO-101 cameras, in the same field layout as so101_camera_rig*.json cameras.<name>.intrinsics / .distortion, so it can be dropped into a rig file. NO mount pose here: the wrist poses in the existing rig files were fitted with the old (wrong, pincushion) lenses and must be refitted with these lenses before use in sim.
measured: 2026-11-13 on dzkchen, ChArUco 9x6 squares, DICT_5X5_100, shown full screen on a laptop; captures from molmo_runner 'Calibration capture'; 640x480 MJPG via DirectShow (the runner's live mode). cv2.calibrateCamera 5-coefficient model.
hardware_model: InnoMaker U20CAM-1080P-S1 (all three rig cameras per user); 640x480 is the centre 4:3 crop of the 1080p sensor

left_wrist.fit_note: tuned ArUco detection + gamma retry; half-split spread fx +-7 px, k1 +-0.008. Another fit of the same captures by inference-testing-04 (21 views, default detection) gave fx 527.4, cx 301.4, cy 256.2, dist [-0.442, 0.286, -0.004, 0.004, -0.115]: same lens, fx ~2.4% lower.

right_wrist.fit_note: 17 views, poor coverage of the left/bottom of the image: initialised from the left lens and k3 held at the left value. Every right frame fits the LEFT lens at 0.17-0.62 px, i.e. same lens type. Half-split spread fx +-7 px, k1 +-0.009.

overhead.status: GOOD (focal length + centre measured; distortion inherited from the wrists)
overhead.fit_note: By inference-testing-04 from a 300-frame every-frame board capture (85 views with >= 12 corners). Distortion fixed to the mean of the measured left/right wrist lenses (same model): the bottom third of the overhead image had no board corners, so a free fit diverged (fx 1167). fx = fy, centre free; fx 543.6-545.2 across 3 folds. Fixing the centre at the image middle fits clearly worse (0.37 px). Replaces the provisional 0a fit (fx 571, 13 top-half views). Raw file: lens_raw/lens_overhead_2026-11-13_070544.json.
